## findings

- **T0-F1 SOURCE-FACTOR RED — the refund computation has no honest method factor.** Symptom: the only factor labelled `method` in taxacct_ext_credit_refund_request is `estimate_hold`, whose tiers are the numbers 0 / 0.5 / 1 multiplied onto the same expression. Root cause: mislabelled effect (charter-global, `_difficulty.md` §factor_ladders and §findings F-1). Evidence: rule "An estimate hold then scales what is left: ... exactly one scales it by the one-estimate hold factor, and none leaves it whole ... times the estimate hold factor"; compute `estimate_hold_factor: 0 if recent_estimates >= 2 else (K('one_estimate_hold_factor') if recent_estimates == 1 else 1)` and `result: RND(MX(0, ...) * estimate_hold_factor, 2)`. Demonstrated consequence on this world: the factor moves the scored value only as a number does (587.03 at factor 1 vs 293.52 at 0.5, same formula); counting honest labels, computations[1] has 4 parameter and 0 method factors, below the bound of at least 1 method per computation. Affected: `taxacct.extended.yaml` taxacct_ext_credit_refund_request.factors[estimate_hold].effect; `tasks/0.json` computations[1].factor_trace[3] and design_rationale "refund 4: 3 parameter + 1 method". Previous revisions: none.
- **T0-F2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (PLAUSIBLE: rests on reading "distinct records" as distinct rows) — no multi-source factor in the task.** Symptom: no factor of computations[0] or [1] has every non-fall-through tier as a conjunction/disjunction over distinct records. Evidence: estimate_wage_basis_rule tier 1 "the most recently filed original report's taxable wages are at least the rising wage ratio times the recent-report average" is a single comparison; appeal_interest_allowance tiers ("decided as reversed and the decision came more than the long appeal days after filing"; "reversed within the long appeal days, or decided as modified more than the long appeal days after filing") combine `decision_outcome`, `filed_date` and `decision_mailed_date` of the single row `appeals/362eb037-...`; workforce_growth_factor tiers read one report row; the other five factors are single counts. Demonstrated consequence: the task's computations carry 0 multi-source factors (bound >= 1); the dossier's contrary claim is the false assertion noted above. Affected: `tasks/0.json` design_rationale "Task-level floors"; charter factor ladders of the two claimed policies. Previous revisions: none.
- T0-O1 observation: `credit_payment_entry_id` requires an inference the charter does not state (which payment "created" a credit born of a rate-reduction credit adjustment); resolved to 33efc05b by the payment-application rule, matching GT.
- T0-O2 observation: _difficulty.md O-12 (realism of the reporting cushion and contribution hold) bears on this task's figure; no red light.
